audit.source_state: Existing local documentation changes preserved; deployment commit identity not established

summary.score_label: Provisional observed SEO readiness, not a complete health measurement or Google score
summary.business_type: Personal software-development / creative-technology portfolio with project study and browser-extension landing page
top_findings: Invisible keyboard focus on several shared links and query buttons
Grailed Plus demo unavailable states and independent direct-fetch timeout; root cause and persistence unverified
Photo Graph no-scroll capture completed 120 image responses / 4221724 encoded bytes
Benchmark labels omit judged-candidate filtering and seven-query model-average scope
Visible project contribution context is less explicit than the existing creator schema
quick_wins: Correct benchmark definitions and aggregate labels
Add owner-confirmed contribution context from the shared catalog
Defer and appropriately size below-fold comparison imagery
Identify Grailed Plus as a Chrome extension in existing product metadata

categories.name: Technical SEO
categories.score_type: Scoped live-check heuristic; not Google index coverage
what_works: 154 bounded assertions passed, zero failed
Three HTTP-200 self-canonical public pages with meaningful raw text and simulated user-agent parity
Valid sitemap, deliberate noindex experiences, working permanent legacy redirects

findings.title: Legacy graph fallback retains retired Supabase media assumptions
findings.status: source-only, already documented; not reproduced live
findings.description: Static fallback nodes without a provider normalize to Supabase even though retained originals were retired.
findings.recommendation: Separately repair/rebuild provider-qualified fallback paths and test the branch in isolation; do not mutate production storage during diagnosis.

findings.title: Extra permanent HTTP/www entry redirect hops
findings.status: confirmed live inefficiency, not indexing blocker
findings.description: http://www.dextery.dev/ takes three 308 redirects to /portfolio; final destinations and query preservation work.
findings.recommendation: Optional consolidation only during approved hosting maintenance; preserve canonical homepage routing.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Original work, real methodological evidence, disclosed benchmark scope and limitations
Named owner, public contact/CV and consistent official profile/Store signals
No arbitrary word-count or generic blogging requirement

findings.title: Benchmark definitions and aggregate scope are imprecise
findings.description: P@4 filters to judged candidates before selecting four; active-query cards display model averages across seven queries. The displayed numbers are explainable, not alleged fabrication.
findings.recommendation: Qualify judged-candidate denominator and seven-query averages, retaining the historical benchmark date and corpus scope.

findings.title: Project contribution and ownership remain inferred
findings.status: confirmed content gap; owner facts required before changes
findings.description: Artifact summaries and stack are visible, but personal responsibility/collaboration/result context is less explicit. Internal TBD values are not public placeholders.
findings.recommendation: Use short owner-confirmed contribution and supported outcome context in the shared catalog and existing views.

findings.title: Maker/support/privacy signposting is indirect on Grailed Plus
findings.status: page-level clarity opportunity, not ecosystem absence or policy violation
findings.description: The Store already supplies matching developer/contact/disclosure context, one destination away.
findings.recommendation: Link existing current disclosures and maker/support context accurately; distinguish extension behavior from landing-page analytics.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles/descriptions
Coherent headings and meaningful SSR copy
Metadata-template risk low across all three pages

findings.title: Grailed Plus metadata leads with demos rather than product category
findings.description: Current metadata enumerates features and invites live demos but does not explicitly name the Chrome-extension category.
findings.recommendation: Lead existing metadata with the installable Chrome extension and main benefit, using verified positioning.

findings.title: Informative comparison-image alternatives are only rank/ID
findings.description: Rank and image ID repeat captions rather than explaining the visual similarity evidence. Empty query-thumbnail alts are appropriate with adjacent labels.
findings.recommendation: Curate concise subject/colour descriptions for the finite informative comparison set without requiring a database migration.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
categories.score_type: Syntax, vocabulary and entity-relationship heuristic; no hosted external validator submission
what_works: Six JSON-LD blocks parse
Zero dangling references
Appropriate Person/WebSite/page/image/CreativeWork/ItemList entities

findings.title: Optional pixel typing and stable project entity IDs
findings.description: Strict dimension vocabulary ranges and explicit project identity can be refined; current graphs are not malformed or demonstrated indexing blockers.
findings.recommendation: Consider typed pixel values and stable project IDs only if useful; never invent reviews, ratings or offers for rich results.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
categories.score_type: Not scored: PSI 429; no CrUX/INP or Lighthouse dataset
what_works: Useful bounded local browser resource measurements available
No demonstrated field CWV, TTFB or CLS failure

findings.title: Photo Graph initial image work is substantial
findings.status: measured optimization opportunity, not a field CWV verdict
findings.description: Single unthrottled 390x844/DPR3 no-scroll capture completed 120 image responses / 4221724 encoded bytes; 2984361 canvas-image bytes and 1237363 comparison-image bytes.
findings.recommendation: First defer/resize below-fold comparison images; then measure whether graph activation/concurrency changes justify the experience tradeoff.

findings.title: Root fonts consume 246 KB of initial portfolio transfer
findings.description: Six fonts account for 246122 bytes and 45.4% of the observed primary portfolio mobile payload.
findings.recommendation: Compare WOFF2 and truly initial-face preloads while preserving typography and avoiding new CLS/FOIT.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
categories.score_type: GEO content/entity heuristic with separate agentic access corroboration; actual citation visibility unknown
what_works: Readable initial HTML and relevant original evidence
Existing Person/sameAs and creator relations
Four representative UA strings receive identical unchallenged HTTP-200 homepage HTML
notes: Contribution and benchmark clarity findings are already represented in Content Quality, not duplicated as extra defects

Homepage Agent-UX naming score is not a whole-site task-success or Lighthouse Agentic score

Sample query selection works with Enter
Appropriate portfolio/study/product entry-page separation

findings.title: Keyboard focus is invisible on several controls
findings.description: Affected focused links/query buttons compute outline style none with no visible alternative, despite functional keyboard activation.
findings.recommendation: Restore explicit visible focus styling and verify pointer/keyboard behavior in both themes.

findings.title: Grailed Plus demo did not become ready
findings.status: investigation priority; observed captures, root cause/persistence unknown
findings.description: Desktop/mobile captures reached unavailable fallback; independent direct fetch timed out after 30 seconds. First-party copy and Store links remain.
findings.recommendation: Diagnose availability and ready handshake, preserve useful static proof/retry and official install path; approve service fixes separately.

notes: Two is a verified sample, not site-wide backlink/referring-domain total
